# Halvard Systems Vendor Security Standard (2025 Edition)

Vendor security standard of Halvard Systems, 2025 edition. Synthetic evaluation material for a fictional company.

## Purpose and Scope

This standard sets the security controls Halvard Systems requires from vendors that host or process Halvard Systems systems data.

## Encryption Requirement

Vendor systems must encrypt Halvard Systems data in transit with current transport security and at rest with platform-managed keys.

## Incident Notification

A vendor must notify Halvard Systems of a confirmed security incident within seventy-two (72) hours of discovery.

## Access Review

Vendor access to Halvard Systems systems is reviewed every six months and removed within five business days of a role change.
